To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the TiO2/TicxO1-x composite shows the significant change in the mechanical properties, thermal conductivity and Seeback coefficient by changing the interface condition.
the TiO2/TicxO1−x nano-ceramic composite is a novel and promising material for the future application.
TiO2/TixC1-x nano-ceramic composites with Ti/C ratio = 50:30 were successfully prepared by spark plasma sintered (SPS) route at different temperature with different reinforcing constituent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of the novel TiO2/TixO1−x nanocomposite with the different TiO2/Tic ratio.
the development of TiO2-based composite materials, which have the potential to be utilized as thermoelectric materials.
the development of novel TiO2/TixO1−x nano-composite with high hardness and toughness.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the thermal conductivity of TiO2/ TiCxO1-x composite is strongly influenced by the nature of the reinforcing constituents, their volume fraction, the nature of the interface and the thermal boundary resistance.
the thermal conductivity is strongly influenced by the nature and concentration of charge carriers.
the SPS processed composite materials have a great potential for use in the thermal barrier coatings and other high temperature application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TiO2/TixC1−x composite materials are promising candidate for the high temperature applications.
the SPS processed TiO2/TixCxO1−1 composite materials with nano TiCx reinforcement shows superior mechanical properties and thermal conductivity.
the SPS process is very useful for the fabrication of TiO2/ TiCxO1-x composite with different reinforcing constituents at the different temperature with different charge carrier nature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SPS processed TiO2/TixC1−x composite shows excellent properties.
the SPS processed nano TiO2/TixO1−x composites with Ti/C ratio of 50/30 can be used as a potential candidate for the thermoelectric applications.
the interface between reinforcement and matrix plays a crucial role in the charge carrier transfer and hence in the thermoelectric properties of the material.
